By sending, you confirm that you may send the details of the other adults on this booking.

consent.title: Confirm
consent.label: I have read and agree to the above
consent.text: We collect your identity details (name, date of birth, document number, nationality, address), your phone number, the photo of your CCCD and the health information you give (allergies, medicines, reason for the visit). Health information is sensitive data. Purpose: preparing and carrying out your visit. The CCCD photo is deleted within 30 days. By sending, you confirm the details are yours (or those of a child in your care) and agree to the clinic handling them as described.
